name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional

fee.note: USD list price. An unused eligible AWS certification benefit could reduce the exam fee; no voucher was checked.

exam.format: 75 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 180 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS targets production developers with two years of application experience and one year implementing GenAI.

scope: Building, deploying and troubleshooting production generative AI applications on AWS.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.

discounts.text: After you earn an AWS Certification, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher for recertification or any other AWS exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 14 calendar days; there is no limit on attempts, but each one costs the full exam fee.
access.accommodations: Non-native English speakers taking the exam in English can request 30 extra minutes (ESL +30) once in their AWS Certification account; it then applies to every booking.
